name: Chana Masala with Basmati Rice

components.name: Chana Masala

ingredients.name: Canned chickpeas drained and rinsed, measured after draining

steps: Rinse and drain canned chickpeas; weigh the drained amount. If using dried chickpeas instead, soaking and cooking weights need separate conversion.
Heat oil in a wide covered saucepan; soften chopped onion for 6-8 minutes, then add garlic and ginger.
Add tomatoes, garam masala, coriander, cumin, turmeric and salt; cook until tomato mixture becomes concentrated, 8-12 minutes.
Add drained chickpeas and measured water and simmer covered for 15-20 minutes; crush a few chickpeas to thicken.
Portion curry and rice into four containers and top with chopped coriander after reheating.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Meanwhile rinse raw rice, cover with measured water, cook until fluffy and rest covered for 10 minutes.
